item.title: Sabae Glasses: Japan's Eyewear Capital and Factory Tours — Guide
item.description: Sabae is Japan’s eyewear capital, producing the vast majority of the country’s domestically-made glasses frames and internationally recognised for pioneering the manufacture of lightweight, durable titanium frames in the early 1980s. Visitors can explore this precision craft industry through the Megane Museum (Glasses Museum), which combines exhibits, a shop selling locally-made frames and hands-on workshops, alongside factory tours at some manufacturers offering a look at the detailed process behind Sabae’s world-class eyewear.
